name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a 3px focus ring to every interactive element that gets keyboard focus—buttons, links, form fields, even custom widgets—using a high-contrast color like #005FCC on a white background. This makes the focus state visible to low-vision keyboard users without changing the visual design for mouse users. Trade-off: the ring adds a tiny visual bump, but it’s necessary for WCAG 2.2 AA compliance and costs nothing in performance.

name: Reader
text: A 3px focus ring risks shrinking already tight touch targets on mobile, where 44×44 px is the bare minimum. Better: use a 2px ring with 2px outer glow to preserve space while keeping contrast high. Settle it by testing with a screen reader user on a low-vision keyboard-only setup—if they can’t track focus, widen the ring to 3px.
